officialTitle: First-Line Selpercatinib or Chemotherapy and Pembrolizumab in RET Fusion-Positive NSCLC

design.blinding: PFS by blinded independent central review
design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: Efficacy results in the overall intention-to-treat population (261 patients) were similar to those in the intention-to-treat-pembrolizumab population.
design.notes: Crossover from control to selpercatinib allowed at BICR-confirmed progression.

clinicalQuestion: Is first-line selpercatinib superior to platinum-based chemotherapy with or without pembrolizumab in advanced RET fusion-positive NSCLC?

pico.population: Advanced RET fusion-positive NSCLC, previously untreated
pico.comparator: Platinum-based chemotherapy with or without pembrolizumab (investigator's discretion)
pico.outcomes: Primary: BICR PFS. Others: ORR, CNS progression, safety

arms.label: Control
arms.regimen: Platinum-based chemotherapy with or without pembrolizumab

publications.title: First-Line Selpercatinib or Chemotherapy and Pembrolizumab inFusion-Positive NSCLC.
publications.label: Preplanned interim efficacy analysis

outcomes.endpointLabel: PFS by blinded independent central review
outcomes.sourceQuote: In total, 212 patients underwent randomization in the intention-to-treat-pembrolizumab population. At the time of the preplanned interim efficacy analysis, median progression-free survival was 24.8 months (95% confidence interval [CI], 16.9 to not estimable) with selpercatinib and 11.2 months (95% CI, 8.8 to 16.8) with control treatment (hazard ratio for progression or death, 0.46; 95% CI, 0.31 to 0.70; P<0.001).
The percentage of patients with an objective response was 84% (95% CI, 76 to 90) with selpercatinib and 65% (95% CI, 54 to 75) with control treatment.
The cause-specific hazard ratio for the time to progression affecting the central nervous system was 0.28 (95% CI, 0.12 to 0.68).

safety.sourceQuote: The adverse events that occurred with selpercatinib and control treatment were consistent with those previously reported.

strengths: First randomised phase III of a selective RET inhibitor

clinicalImplications.text: Supports first-line selpercatinib over chemo-immunotherapy in RET fusion-positive NSCLC, reinforcing broad driver testing before first-line immunotherapy.

tumourBoardPearl.text: Even against chemotherapy plus pembrolizumab, the targeted RET inhibitor won on PFS — get the RET result before starting first-line therapy.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 37870973. Doses not printed in abstract.
